title: Fast Growing Clinic Network on One HR System
summary: Learn how Neoasia Group built scalable HR systems to streamline hiring, improve performance, and support sustainable growth.
body_markdown:
Scattered spreadsheets became one platform HR and employees could both use, freeing 10–15 admin hours a month for recruitment and engagement.


10–15 hrs


HR hours saved every month


One system


Replacing scattered spreadsheets


## The Company


A growing clinic network offering occupational health and primary care across Penang, from Klinik Inderawasih to its physio and stroke centre.


## The Challenge


Every new clinic added headcount, shifts and paperwork. Attendance, payroll and onboarding were all still run by hand across spreadsheets and folders, and admin grew faster than the HR team could absorb it.


## Why brioHR


One integrated platform instead of disconnected tools. The deciding factor was accessibility on both sides: structure and clear policies for HR, and something simple enough for clinic staff to use between patients.


## The Result


Payroll is more organised, onboarding is simpler, and employees self-serve leave and attendance. The 10–15 hours a month once lost to paperwork now go to recruitment and employee engagement.


“An easy-to-use, all-in-one HR platform that takes the admin off your plate. A better experience for HR and employees alike.”


**Ashiqin** · HR Executive, Auraciel Medihealth Sdn. Bhd.
